_comment: English text that the beta dump does not have yet. Applied by apply_en_overrides.py after gi-dm-localization:gen-file. Set names are provisional translations of the CHS names (肇史之遗, 遥天奉翠华引), chosen by the user on 2026-11-05; piece names follow the beta's own pattern (CHS: set name + slot). Lunaris (data 7.2.50) also only has the CHS names, checked 2026-11-05. Remove an entry once the dump has the official English text. Blazing Lionfang (12438): the dump has its passive only in CHS; the English below is a translation of it (2026-11-06), and the passive name fixes the dump's typo "Convenant".

lines: After the equipping character has been off-field for a total of 5s, they gain the Reforged Blade effect.

Reforged Blade: ATK is increased by {atk}. When the equipping character switches in during combat, they deal AoE DMG equal to {dmg} of their ATK to nearby opponents. This DMG can occur once every 14s. After the equipping character has been on-field for a total of 10s, they lose the Reforged Blade effect.
